rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for someone or something local or based in a particular place.

example.english: A local resident usually knows this area well.
example.traditional: 本地居民通常都熟悉呢區。
example.jyutping: bun2 dei6 geoi1 man4 tung1 soeng4 dou1 suk6 sik1 ni1 keoi1

rows.note: Use this specifically for an expert, worker, or service that is stationed on site and available there.

example.english: There is a resident doctor on site today, so you can find them right away if anything happens.
example.traditional: 今日有駐場醫生，有事可以即刻搵佢。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 jau5 zyu3 coeng4 ji1 sang1 jau5 si6 ho2 ji5 zik1 hak1 wan2 keoi5

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person who lives in a particular place or area.

example.english: A resident in this area said it was too noisy downstairs.
example.traditional: 呢區有個居民話樓下太嘈。
example.jyutping: ni1 keoi1 jau5 go3 geoi1 man4 waa6 lau4 haa6 taai3 cou4

rows.note: Use this for someone who lives in a place continuously rather than merely visiting.

example.english: We are resident occupants of this building, not short-term renters.
example.traditional: 我哋係呢棟大廈嘅常住客，唔係短租客。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai6 ni1 dung6 daai6 haa6 ge3 soeng4 zyu6 haak3 m4 hai6 dyun2 zou1 haak3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a doctor undertaking postgraduate hospital training.

example.english: My friend is a resident doctor and often has to work night shifts.
example.traditional: 我朋友係住院醫生，成日要返夜更。
example.jyutping: ngo5 pang4 jau5 hai6 zyu6 jyun2 ji1 sang1 seng4 jat6 jiu3 faan1 je6 gang1

rows.note: Use this for someone with official legal permanent-resident status, rather than merely someone who has lived somewhere for a long time.

example.english: They got permanent resident status and can finally relax.
example.traditional: 佢攞到永久居民身份，終於可以放心喇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 lo2 dou3 wing5 gau2 geoi1 man4 san1 fan6 zung1 jyu1 ho2 ji5 fong3 sam1 laa3

rows.note: Use this technical term for a bird that stays in the same area throughout the year instead of migrating.

example.english: Sparrows are common resident birds in Hong Kong.
example.traditional: 麻雀係香港常見嘅留鳥。
example.jyutping: maa4 zoek3 hai6 hoeng1 gong2 soeng4 gin3 ge3 lau4 niu5
